B1d room ireland (order 541, group 2: the B1b room note left kinds for B1d in t03, t06, t07, t08, t10, t14, t15 and t16) reread: A1 note, 16 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (112 threads, 915 lines, not cut). Two changes, both bags (out/_analysis/b1d05_bags_ireland.txt, checked with b1_precheck_bagfile.py and b1_check_bags.py; the rule 0 writer wrote four tier lines, tier_history 95 lines). t03 (making, growing and mending the fleg) held T3-065 with T3-003 and T3-091; the reread found two more kinds carried by concept groups of their own, calls to get the flag on the yoke and grow it (c0063, c0065, c0070, c0155) and pride in it (c0050, c0051, c0098, c0152), with complaints and a call to fix its state (c0021, c0031, c0069); it is now one placement in T3-065 with T3-003, T3-091, T3-002, T3-009 and T3-021 in the bag line. t06 (calling raids and taking more canvas) held T3-061 with T3-006 and T3-024; the reread found the Irish-British conflict carried into the raids, 'Anyone feel like taking over the Union Jack with Republican slogans?' (c0033), 'If things go south write IRA on it and nobody will want to touch it' (c0084), 'Retake the north on r/place' (c0252), removing Northern Ireland from the Union Jack (c0258), 'Write IRA on the English flag' (c0352); it is now one placement in T3-061 with T3-006, T3-024 and T3-081 in the bag line. T3-003, T3-091, T3-006 and T3-024 were unplaced. The rest hold: finding the work (t01 T3-016 with T3-070), the Irish-language thread (t02 T3-017 with T3-016 and T3-095), what goes on the fleg, Up the Ra and the bans (t04 bag under T3-080), holding the line (t05 T3-005 with T3-081 and T3-150), mocking and tiring (t07 T3-037 with T3-075 and T3-145), neighbours (t08 bag under T3-010, 97 concepts), the Vatican joke (t09 T3-001), megathreads and scripts (t10 bag under T3-015), the edit test (t11 T3-074 with T3-006), side causes (t12 T3-160 with T3-084), the personal row (t13 T3-050 with T3-084), keepsakes (t14 T3-156 with T3-105 and T3-018), the stop and thanks (t15 bag under T3-157), friendships after (t16 T3-158 with T3-072 and T3-031). Kinds missing from existing bags, recorded here: t08 the wall politics as T3-130 or T3-080 in about a dozen concepts ('the wall stands against immigrants which to be fair us Irish are like the OG immigrants so I say we fight', c0241; c0240, c0255, c0265 to c0267, c0273, c0275, c0276, c0307, c0308, c0316, c0496), T3-142 (c0347, an outsider's slur 'potato niggers'), T3-195 (c0290, c0291), T3-194 (c0136) and, for c0274 (a carrying code), the moderators declining a stance ('We can't really control you lads, so if you feel like fighting, go for it!'), near T3-140; t15 T3-073 (c0393, c0395, c0397, c0399, c0509, c0511, the invasion of the US flag recounted), T3-027 (c0379, c0433, c0434) and T3-117 (c0385, c0386); t10 T3-027 (c0284, c0285) and T3-075 (c0340, c0346). Single concepts named here: t07 c0037 ('Hun sabotage', a sectarian jibe, near T3-142), c0024 (the marriage referendum joke, near T3-130), c0492 and c0510 (near T3-076); t14 c0381 (near T3-079); t16 c0438 and c0451 (game keys offered in thanks, near T3-159). National and political content read plainly: 'Tiocfaidh ár lá' and 'Up the Ra' on the flag, condemned as sectarian and threatened with bans (c0001, c0003, c0062, c0109, c0138, c0139), Gerry Adams (c0113), 'radical republican agenda' (c0219), a hard border with checkpoints joked (c0107, c0108); 'feckin brits keep sabotaging the flag' (c0058) and 'we resisted against bigger empires' (c0104); Wales and Scotland called to destroy the Union Jack (c0228, c0229); r/rotmg made 'officially Fenians ... in favour of a 32 county Republic' (c0298); Trump's wall refused, 'the United States of Trumpland' (c0307), r/the_donald blamed (c0316, c0375, c0496); the strategy 'cribbed from feudalism ... given the history of this island and its neighbours' (c0422); empathy with a Bosnian flag 'destroyed by the expansion of a colonial power' (c0446); r/lgbt's 'Stop the Hate' over the early flag (c0016, c0053). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: the moderators declined a stance (c0274) and herded talk into megathreads (c0231, c0249). No new kind; the run is not reset.

B1d room Slovakia (order 550, group 2: the B1b room note left kinds for B1d in t02, t03, t04, t05 and t12) reread: A1 note, 16 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (58 threads, 299 lines, not cut). No change. t02 (the Slovakia/Slovenia April Fools mix-up) stays in T3-023: the joke threads were r/slovenia's April Fools action in this room (E943), and slovenia t01 holds the same episode in T3-023; T3-032 is not reached, since only c0003 and c0004 object. For B1e, T3-023's label (already listed to say the sub's takeover) should also say whether one sub's joke raid on another counts. t05's carrying code c0048 ('Takto sa nam zachova nasa vlajka', accepting Norway's terms) is carried by T3-149 with the vote and the repair-for-expansion trade (c0046, c0047, c0050), so T3-099 is not needed. The rest hold: where and what to build (t01 T3-020 with T3-004), holding and repairing (t03 T3-005 with T3-021 and T3-042), the Czech brothers and D2 (t04 T3-056 with T3-072 and T3-150), memes and The Defiance (t06 T3-057 with T3-081), the drop spared and Slovak hearts (t07 T3-024 with T3-060), Slack and Discord (t08 T3-014), wider help (t09 T3-011 with T3-022 and T3-056), the end (t10 T3-073 with T3-054), redirected attacks (t11 T3-006), how the flag survived (t12 T3-073 with T3-145 and T3-072), migration and old-regime jokes (t13 T3-130 with T3-031), discovering the sub (t14 T3-016 with T3-044), pride argued (t15 T3-145 with T3-037), timelapse names (t16 T3-052 with T3-017). Single concepts named here: c0029 (checking accounts and blaming r/shawnhate, near T3-087), c0031 (calling r/europe against a Russian takeover, near T3-084), c0021 (connected flags with a heart, near T3-079), c0045 and c0083 (fight or move weighed, near T3-124), c0035 (the treaty reaffirmed, near T3-195), c0034 (r/Shawnhate asking the room to stop attacking, near T3-139), c0069 (near T3-009), c0076 (saving the flag 'from Norway's aggression', near T3-154). National and political content read plainly: 'Czechia and Slovakia brothership ... We are still truly Czechoslovakians!' (c0075) and the Czechoslovak motorway D2 (c0022, c0036); 'CZECHOSLOVAKIA IS A REMNANT OF THE OLD OPRESSIVE REGIME' (c0077) answered with 'Glory to Arstotska' (c0081); Czechs 'stealing our work' (c0059, c0060); 'Do not let Russia to overtake Slovakia flag' (c0031) and an uncoded 'Ruskies. Who else could it be'; Norway's attack, vote and terms (c0046 to c0048, c0050) and 'The Defiance: Norway and Slovakia locked in a staring contest, 1941' (c0051); 'Slovensko je skromný národ ... len náš malý kúsok domoviny' (c0057); national pride disputed (c0071 to c0074); a pan-Slavic flag (c0049); an uncoded 'the government in exile works again'. The A1 note's 'not this' holds: the flag was kept by Norway's vote and accepted terms (c0047, c0048). No new kind; the run is not reset.

B1d room unitedkingdom (order 553, group 2: the B1b room note left kinds for B1d in t01, t02, t04, t07, t09 and t10) reread: A1 note, 11 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (97 threads, 598 lines, not cut). One change, a bag (out/_analysis/b1d05_bags_unitedkingdom.txt, checked; the rule 0 writer wrote two tier lines, tier_history 97 lines): t04 (routing work through coordinates, scripts, templates and side venues) held T3-070 with T3-028 and T3-090; two carrying codes of the A1 note carry kinds of their own, 'There are three separate flags being made at once, and we're just acting as obstacles' (c0013, with c0161 and c0162 on the main Union Jack's organisation), complaining the calls are scattered (T3-049), and 'This is a shit show. We need someone in charge.' (c0016), putting one member in charge (T3-101), beside the Discord made to fix it (c0015, T3-014). It is now one placement in T3-070 with T3-028, T3-090, T3-049, T3-101 and T3-014 in the bag line; T3-028 and T3-090 were unplaced. t09 (April Fools) keeps T3-001 with T3-032: the Daily Mail concepts (c0083 to c0085) are the room's own satire, a parody headline among them, not a test of a claim, so T3-095 is not added. The rest hold: building and defending the Union Jack (t01 T3-002 with T3-021 and T3-005), truces (t02 bag under T3-149), which symbols belong (t03 bag under T3-004), scripts and fair play (t05 T3-027 with T3-089 and T3-042; c0270, a carrying code, admitting the bots were used for expansion, is part of that argument), celebrating and reusing (t06 T3-009 with T3-105 and T3-156), policing canvas talk (t07 T3-015 with T3-075), banter and self-mockery (t08 bag under T3-081), raids (t10 bag under T3-006), anti-Brexit messages rejected (t11 T3-080). Kinds missing from existing bags, recorded here: t02 T3-194 (c0034, c0185, c0192, c0283, c0284, envoys coming in peace) and T3-072 (c0022, c0259); t10 T3-081 (c0186 'We took the Falklands so why wont we take Argentina altogether', c0279 the Belgrano drawn). Two-concept kinds named here: t01 T3-059 (c0032 'Fuck'em?', c0060 'Please just let it die') and T3-087 (c0213, c0216); t07 T3-063 (c0156, c0246); t09 T3-143 (c0081 'Fuck the casual racism that permeates this sub', c0082). National and political content read plainly: the Falklands, HMS Conqueror and the Belgrano (c0036, c0186, c0279); 'Germany needs more lebensraum on r/place' (c0106), the third Franco-German war (c0109 to c0113), 'For two world wars the French and british have stood together against the germans' (c0146), 'the old gang' against 'the Jerries' (c0134); 'Operation GREAT Britain' (c0169), 'Rule Britannia' and 'Our beautiful empire is back' (c0280, c0281), 'doing what the British do best; Colonising' (c0260); Brexit on the canvas proposed and refused (c0148, c0150, c0151, c0234), 'April 1st first casualty of Brexit' (c0074), Cameron and the referendum (c0067), a fake May resignation (c0064); the Saltire turned into the St George flag and a phallus proposed on it (c0249, c0250), the Irish flag in the Union flag (c0190), 'Lets Unite the Kingdoms' answered with 'we all seem to hate each other' (c0224, c0229); Gibraltar (c0251); the Queen (c0209, c0245); 'make the Italians pay for a wall' (c0063); Mexico's plea for mercy (c0261); a Daily Mail parody headline 'SICK APRIL FOOL IMMIGRANT HORROR' (c0084) and casual racism called out (c0081). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: members called it 'a shit show' needing someone in charge (c0016), with three flags obstructing one another (c0013). No new kind; the run is not reset.
